title: Sordland/Turn07/Personal_UniversityChoice
description: Discussion with Franc about university choice and admission.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I arrived home from work, hung my j..."
entries.dialogueText: I arrived home from work, hung my jacket up, and put my briefcase in the hall.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Darling, what's wrong?""
entries.dialogueText: "Darling, what's wrong?"
entries.menuText: "Darling, what's wrong?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who is it from?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who is it from?"
entries.menuText: "Who is it from?"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I sat down on the couch next to Mon..."
entries.dialogueText: I sat down on the couch next to Monica.
entries.menuText: Sit down next to Monica.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""It's from the Department of Educat..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's from the Department of Education. Franc's university exam results are in."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How did he do?""
entries.dialogueText: "How did he do?"
entries.menuText: "How did he do?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why are you so worried, then?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why are you so worried, then?"
entries.menuText: "Why are you so worried, then?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He failed, didn't he?""
entries.dialogueText: "He failed, didn't he?"
entries.menuText: "He failed, didn't he?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Just read the letter.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just read the letter."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at the page. Below Franc's..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at the page. Below Franc's name and address, his score was written: 435 points, out of a total of 1000.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the bottom of the letter, the wo..."
entries.dialogueText: At the bottom of the letter, the word "Failed" was stamped in red.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""All those years of effort, all tho..."
entries.dialogueText: "All those years of effort, all those private lessons... all down the drain."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe it'll be good for him to lea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe it'll be good for him to learn from his mistakes."
entries.menuText: "Maybe it'll be good for him to learn from his mistakes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Does he know the results yet?""
entries.dialogueText: "Does he know the results yet?"
entries.menuText: "Does he know the results yet?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He brought this upon himself.""
entries.dialogueText: "He brought this upon himself."
entries.menuText: "He brought this upon himself."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""This isn't just about Franc, you k..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't just about Franc, you know. Him failing will reflect badly on you. On us."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""No, but he should be back from sch..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, but he should be back from school soon."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I just don't understand. Franc's a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just don't understand. Franc's a smart boy -- why would he sabotage himself like this?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard a key turning in the front..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard a key turning in the front door. Franc stomped in and was about to go straight upstairs when he noticed us both in the living room.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I waited for Monica to start the co..."
entries.dialogueText: I waited for Monica to start the conversation.
entries.menuText: Wait for Monica to start the conversation.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Have a seat, Franc.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a seat, Franc."
entries.menuText: "Have a seat, Franc."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a seat across from us, and..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a seat across from us, and I handed him the letter. He started reading it.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Your exam results arrived today.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your exam results arrived today."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc sat down, and Monica handed h..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc sat down, and Monica handed him the letter. He started reading it.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Oh, shit.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, shit."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I... I need a moment.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... I need a moment."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He went to the kitchen sink and was..."
entries.dialogueText: He went to the kitchen sink and washed his face. A moment later, he came back.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I never thought this would happen...."
entries.dialogueText: "I never thought this would happen. I'm so sorry."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's my fault. I should have been..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's my fault. I should have been around to help you study."
entries.menuText: "It's my fault. I should have been around to help you study."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How could you let us down like thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "How could you let us down like this?"
entries.menuText: "How could you let us down like this?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You made your mother cry with your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You made your mother cry with your actions."
entries.menuText: "You made your mother cry with your actions."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's not the end of the world.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's not the end of the world."
entries.menuText: "It's not the end of the world."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Pretty close, though, isn't it?""
entries.dialogueText: "Pretty close, though, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I know, I know, I can't do anythin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, I know, I can't do anything right!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So it seems.""
entries.dialogueText: "So it seems."
entries.menuText: "So it seems."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not so fast. There might be someth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not so fast. There might be something I can do."
entries.menuText: "Not so fast. There might be something I can do."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Anton. Isn't there *anything* you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton. Isn't there *anything* you can do?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""If Alphonso could get his dimwit s..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Alphonso could get his dimwit son into Kingshill University, I'm sure Holsord State would have room for a bright boy like Franc."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'm going upstairs after him.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going upstairs after him."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Leave him be. He needs time.""
entries.dialogueText: "Leave him be. He needs time."
entries.menuText: "Leave him be. He needs time."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I said nothing."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing.
entries.menuText: Say nothing.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Suit yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Suit yourself."
entries.menuText: "Suit yourself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica went upstairs after Franc an..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica went upstairs after Franc and I started reading documents before dinner.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I suppose I need some time as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose I need some time as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica left the living room and I s..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica left the living room and I started reading newspapers before dinner.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica went upstairs after Franc an..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica went upstairs after Franc and I started reading documents before dinner.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""With enough money, I could get you..."
entries.dialogueText: "With enough money, I could get you into Harcard in Arcasia. It's one of the best universities in the world."
entries.menuText: "With enough money, I could get you into Harcard in Arcasia. It's one of the best universities in the world."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""That sounds... great, actually!""
entries.dialogueText: "That sounds... great, actually!"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Anton! I want him to stay in Sordl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton! I want him to stay in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Mom. I've got to get out and exper..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mom. I've got to get out and experience the world sometime. And in Arcasia, people might see me as something more than just the president's son."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I still don't like it, but I under..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still don't like it, but I understand."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""United People's University in Unit..."
entries.dialogueText: "United People's University in United Contana is free. It also has an excellent medical program."
entries.menuText: "United People's University in United Contana is free. It also has an excellent medical program."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Communism, I can dig that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Communism, I can dig that."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Not exactly how I was expecting to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not exactly how I was expecting to spend my student years, but anything's better than the military."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""This is the future of our boy, Ant..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is the future of our boy, Anton. What should we do?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's been decided. You're going to..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been decided. You're going to United Contana, Franc."
entries.menuText: "It's been decided. You're going to United Contana, Franc."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He must have made us proud.""
entries.dialogueText: "He must have made us proud."
entries.menuText: "He must have made us proud."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""See for yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "See for yourself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gone were the days when I could exp..."
entries.dialogueText: Gone were the days when I could expect a warm welcome from my family. Franc was either at school, barricaded in his room or out with friends. Deana spent more and more time at her after-school art classes, and Monica... well, Monica avoided me at all costs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I awaited my usual welcome from Dea..."
entries.dialogueText: I awaited my usual welcome from Deana before realizing she was out at one of her art classes. Franc was still at school, and Monica... it had been a long time since she'd come to the door to greet me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I paused, awaiting my usual greetin..."
entries.dialogueText: I paused, awaiting my usual greeting from my wife and daughter. Deana was out at one of her after-school art classes, I remembered. But where was Monica?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From the living room, I heard a muf..."
entries.dialogueText: From the living room, I heard a muffled sob.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I entered to find Monica sitting on..."
entries.dialogueText: I entered to find Monica sitting on the sofa, a letter in her hands and a look of despair on her face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica briefly rested her head on m..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica briefly rested her head on my shoulder, then handed me the letter.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica pointedly moved a few inches..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica pointedly moved a few inches away from me, then handed me the letter.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""You know what this means -- he's g..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know what this means -- he's going to have to join the military. He could die, Anton!"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""He did this to get back at you, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "He did this to get back at you, you know. Maybe if you had been there for him more often..."

entries.title: Franc: ""Hi, Mom. What's going on?""
entries.dialogueText: "Hi, Mom. What's going on?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Mom? Dad? What's going on?""
entries.dialogueText: "Mom? Dad? What's going on?"

entries.title: Player: ""Franc! Language!""
entries.dialogueText: "Franc! Language!"
entries.menuText: "Franc! Language!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's all you have to say?""
entries.dialogueText: "That's all you have to say?"
entries.menuText: "That's all you have to say?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Son, we're not angry at you...""
entries.dialogueText: "Son, we're not angry at you..."
entries.menuText: "Son, we're not angry at you..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're a disappointment to this fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're a disappointment to this family, Franc."
entries.menuText: "You're a disappointment to this family, Franc."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Do you think I give a fuck?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think I give a fuck?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica gasped."
entries.dialogueText: Monica gasped.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Right, you should've taken a break..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right, you should've taken a break from running the country to help your loser son!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc looked close to tears. Monica..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc looked close to tears. Monica put her hand on his shoulder.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""It's all about you, isn't it? You..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's all about you, isn't it? You don't care that I bombed the test. You just care how it makes you look!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How dare you speak to your parents..."
entries.dialogueText: "How dare you speak to your parents that way!"
entries.menuText: "How dare you speak to your parents that way!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My image doesn't matter. This is y..."
entries.dialogueText: "My image doesn't matter. This is your future we're talking about."
entries.menuText: "My image doesn't matter. This is your future we're talking about."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're right. The President of Sor..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. The President of Sordland cannot have a failure for a son!"
entries.menuText: "You're right. The President of Sordland cannot have a failure for a son!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica put her hand on his shoulder..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica put her hand on his shoulder. She glared at me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica put her hand on his shoulder..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica put her hand on his shoulder.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I know it's been a rough time. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know it's been a rough time. But you really should have studied harder, Franc."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc's face crumpled."
entries.dialogueText: Franc's face crumpled.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""It's going to be okay. But you rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's going to be okay. But you really should have studied harder, Franc."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Yes!""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not going to take life lessons..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going to take life lessons from Ewald Alphonso."
entries.menuText: "I'm not going to take life lessons from Ewald Alphonso."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Player

entries.menuText: "I do have connections to the board."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It would be nice to have him close..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be nice to have him closer to home."
entries.menuText: "It would be nice to have him closer to home."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I guess it's the army for me, then..."
entries.dialogueText: "I guess it's the army for me, then..."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""So, what am I supposed to do now?""
entries.dialogueText: "So, what am I supposed to do now?"

entries.dialogueText: "Well, there's always military school. But you're the president's son. You still have options."
entries.menuText: "Well, there's always military school. But you're the president's son. You still have options."

entries.dialogueText: Monica surprised me with her enthusiasm.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""But I failed the exam. This sucks...."
entries.dialogueText: "But I failed the exam. This sucks. Are you sure about all of this. Isn't it technically illegal?"

entries.dialogueText: "If you're going to abuse your power to get me into a school, I want it to be as far away from this family as possible."

entries.dialogueText: "Wait. You could also study abroad..."
entries.menuText: "Wait. You could also study abroad..."

entries.menuText: "No. I won't influence your life. You've got to live with what you've done."

entries.dialogueText: "Really? President Anton Rayne suddenly refuses to influence his family members' lives? After banning his wife from politics?"

entries.speaker: Franc
